open_items: execute and retain the clean exact-commit native companion for all three registered targets
review target-specific MIR, LLVM debug-location, object, generated-code, and cfg applicability observations

decide under the applicable controlled basis whether bounded non-debug section-payload equality is sufficient or whether complete source/object mapping or executed object-code structural coverage is required
obtain any required independent review before using the companion for an assurance decision
non_claims: The byte comparison is limited to direct release object section payloads after llvm-objcopy --strip-all; symbols, relocations, and format metadata are excluded, so it does not establish full object, rlib/archive, symbol/relocation identity, or source/object equivalence.
The debuginfo companion is a separate diagnostic build; debug-info settings may alter object code. The byte binding uses a separate debuginfo=0 semantic build with the same release inputs.
MIR, LLVM debug locations, and disassembly are diagnostic evidence; they do not establish complete source/object equivalence or statement/basic-block correspondence.
The companion does not provide executed object-code structural coverage or MC/DC, and it grants no tool qualification, certification credit, or authority acceptance.
